description: Retrieves high-value transactions above a specified amount threshold within a time range. Useful for identifying large suspicious transfers, wire fraud, and outlier transactions.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?startTime AND @timestamp <= ?endTime | WHERE amount >= ?minAmount | KEEP @timestamp, account_id, recipient_account, amount, transaction_type, merchant_category, country_code, risk_score | SORT amount DESC | LIMIT ?limit

startTime.description: Start of the time range in ISO 8601 format

endTime.description: End of the time range in ISO 8601 format

minAmount.description: Minimum transaction amount to include. Defaults to 50000.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 50.
